svg.title: Fusion HCI in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Two storage and compute servers can fail with no data lost, with Data Foundation three-way copy. Up to 405 TB usable in one system of 16 storage and compute servers with ten 7.68 TB drives each. Up to 90X faster remote S3 queries with Fusion HCI’s local caching and watsonx.data.
